events.title: Beginners Welcoming Night
events.description: Our first event of 2025, designed to introduce new members to calisthenics fundamentals and the UACS community. Perfect for beginners and those looking to join our club.

events.title: Handstand Night
events.description: A dedicated session for members to practice and improve their handstand skills, with guidance from experienced members. All skill levels welcome!

events.title: Training Night
events.description: A dynamic training session featuring skill stations, free practice time, and community building. The night concluded with an exciting last-person-standing plank challenge that brought everyone together.

events.title: Placeholder Event
events.description: Welcome to the UACS 2026 Season! We are kicking off this year with masterclasses in handstands, muscle-up progression clinics, and strength training events. Join us to learn calisthenics fundamentals, meet the new committee, and connect with other bodyweight fitness enthusiasts at the University of Auckland.
